milestone.stones.storm_caller.name: Storm Caller
milestone.stones.storm_caller.descriptio: Accumulate static energy with each strike. When capacity is reached, release a massive lightning strike upon your enemies.
milestone.stones.aeon_core.name: Stone Summoning
milestone.stones.aeon_core.description: Teleports you to your Stone for the cost of your wisodm.
milestone.stones.berserker.name: Berserker
milestone.stones.berserker.description: The weaker your body, the stronger your spirit. Deal massive damage at low health and heal through the blood of your enemies.
milestone.stones.void_walker.name: Void Walker
milestone.stones.void_walker.description: Dash in your look direction. Reaching Rune Level 5 grants Slow Falling upon dashing.
runes.stones.minor_camouflage.title: Minor Camouflage Rune
runes.stones.minor_camouflage.descriptio: Slightly reduces your visibility to enemies by blending into your surroundings.
runes.stones.minor_muffling.title: Minor Muffling Rune
runes.stones.minor_muffling.description: Slightly dampens the noise of your movements, making it harder for enemies to hear you.
runes.stones.major_camouflage.title: Major Camouflage Rune
runes.stones.major_camouflage.descriptio: Slightly reduces your visibility to enemies by blending into your surroundings.
runes.stones.major_muffling.title: Major Muffling Rune
runes.stones.major_muffling.description: Slightly dampens the noise of your movements, making it harder for enemies to hear you.
milestone.stones.drowned_warrior.name: Drowned Warrior
milestone.stones.drowned_warrior.descrip: Channel the crushing pressure of the deep. Your strikes consume oxygen to deal massive damage.
milestone.stones.pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
milestone.stones.pyromancer.description: Harness the essence of the Nether. Shoot fireballs that grow faster as you gain power. Level 50+: Release a heat wave on cast.
milestone.stones.gamblers_ruin.name: Gambler's Ruin
milestone.stones.gamblers_ruin.descripti: The ultimate high-stakes gamble. Sacrifice your gear's power for devastating strikes. At level 60, you become a 'High Roller'.
milestone.stones.gladiator.name: Gladiator
milestone.stones.gladiator.description: Each hit increases your combo and damage. Stay in the fight to maintain the chain!
milestone.stones.gravity_well.name: Gravity Well
milestone.stones.gravity_well.descriptio: Collapses space around you, pulling enemies in and crushing them with gravitational force.
milestone.stones.master_prospector.name: Master Prospector
milestone.stones.master_prospector.descr: Send out a deep-earth resonance pulse. Ores will be highlighted with a cubic soul-outline, even through the thickest stone.
milestone.stones.midas_touch.name: Midas Touch
milestone.stones.midas_touch.description: Transforms stone into precious ores based on Luck and Socket Level. Costs XP instantly; the result follows after an alchemical delay.
milestone.stones.necromancer.name: Necromancer
milestone.stones.necromancer.description: Harvest souls of fallen enemies. Efficiency increases with your power and the purity of the shrine.
milestone.stones.night_hunter.name: Night Hunter
milestone.stones.night_hunter.descriptio: Convert darkness into strength. You are weakened during the day, but strike with supernatural power at night.
milestone.stones.phoenix.name: Phoenix
milestone.stones.phoenix.description: The flames are your ally. While burning, you deal massive damage. When on the brink of death, you are reborn from the ashes.
milestone.stones.glacial_thrust.name: Glacial Thrust
milestone.stones.glacial_thrust.descript: Unleash an arcane wave of cold. Enemies in the vicinity are frozen and take frost damage. The range scales with the purity of your shrine.

advancement.stones.root.title: A Whisper from the Void
advancement.stones.root.desc: Find, craft, or obtain your first Runestone block. The cold stone calls to you.
advancement.stones.soul_bond.title: Soul Bond
advancement.stones.soul_bond.desc: Complete the channeling ritual and bind yourself to a shrine. Endure the visions.
advancement.stones.critical_cargo.title: Critical Cargo
advancement.stones.critical_cargo.desc: Successfully mine a bound Runestone. Transport the highly volatile construct without destroying it.
advancement.stones.first_resonance.title: First Resonance
advancement.stones.first_resonance.desc: Socket your first Minor Rune. A fraction of alien power flows through your veins.
advancement.stones.words_of_power.title: Words of Power
advancement.stones.words_of_power.desc: Socket a Major Rune. The physical world bends to your will.
advancement.stones.milestone_path.title: The Path Forms
advancement.stones.milestone_path.desc: Reach the required level to activate a socketed Milestone. You have unlocked a new node of reality.
advancement.stones.growing_resonance.des: Gain your very first passive stat bonus by leveling up with a socketed rune. Your mind grows, and the stone grows with it.
advancement.stones.amplified_echo.title: Amplified Echo
advancement.stones.amplified_echo.desc: Socket a rune enhanced with the Amplify enchantment. Unleash the true potential of the runes.
advancement.stones.singularity.title: Resonance Singularity
advancement.stones.singularity.desc: Obtain a rune with 6 or more enchantments. A completely overloaded, unstable artifact of pure magic.
advancement.stones.echo_wanderer.title: A Wanderer from the Void
advancement.stones.echo_wanderer.desc: Encounter the Echo Trader. Someone... or something... stepped out of the rift.
advancement.stones.shadow_trade.title: Trade in the Shadows
advancement.stones.shadow_trade.desc: Successfully purchase an item from the Echo Trader. Experience for artifacts. A fair trade.
advancement.stones.blood_toll.title: Blood Toll
advancement.stones.blood_toll.desc: Purchase an item from the Echo Trader that demands health as a sacrifice. Flesh is temporary. Power is eternal.
advancement.stones.foolish_pride.title: Foolish Presumption
advancement.stones.foolish_pride.desc: Attack the Echo Trader and survive the curse of the Void. You dared to challenge the wrath of the void.
advancement.stones.legacy_end.title: The End is Just the Beginning
advancement.stones.legacy_end.desc: Die with a score high enough to generate a Resonance Box. Your deeds echo in eternity.
advancement.stones.epitaph.title: Famous Last Words
advancement.stones.epitaph.desc: Enter an epitaph into the global leaderboard. Immortalize your legacy in the stones.
advancement.stones.ancestral_inheritance: Open the leaderboard and claim your earned Resonance Boxes from a past life. Claim the wealth of your fallen predecessors.
advancement.stones.fractals.title: Fractals of the Void
advancement.stones.fractals.desc: Obtain a Cluster Jewel. A bizarre structure holding infinite possibilities.
advancement.stones.order_in_chaos.title: Order in Chaos
advancement.stones.order_in_chaos.desc: Open a Cluster Jewel's inventory and insert or remove a rune. You begin to decipher the fractal.

gui.stones.studio.actionselection.action: Combo Point
Increases the combo counter for an ID. Handles expiration, resetting, and HUD display automatically in one central place.
Update Combo Display
Sets or overrides the active combo HUD display properties for a player or target.
Get Combo
Reads current combo counter and remaining timeout into context variables.
Set Variable
Stores a temporary value or calculation result into an event-bound variable.
Get Persistent NBT
Loads persistent player NBT data into a temporary variable.
Set Persistent NBT
Saves a value permanently into the player's NBT data storage.
Get Attribute
Reads a active Minecraft entity attribute value (e.g., Max Health) into a variable.
Modify Damage
Multiplies or adds flat bonus damage to the current damage event.
Heal player
Restores a defined amount of health (half hearts). Can also scale proportionally.
Cancel Event
Completely cancels the original vanilla Minecraft event (e.g., negates incoming damage).
Cooldown
Blocks the execution of the trigger for a certain period (20 Ticks = 1 Second) to prevent spamming.
Delay
Creates a new subdirectory. All actions placed within will only execute after the ticks elapse.
Branching (If/Else)
Creates a branch. Allows checking conditions for different cases and setting default actions.
For Each Loop
Iterates through each element in a list variable (e.g., found blocks).
Math Operation
Performs mathematical operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) on a variable.
Random Number
Generates a random float within a specified range and stores it in a variable.
Explosion
Creates an explosion at a target position with customizable radius and fire.
Add Velocity
Launches or pushes the player in a specified vector direction.
Set Block
Places or replaces a block at the targeted coordinates.
Find Blocks
Searches for nearby blocks in a radius or raycast line-of-sight and saves them as a list.
X-Ray Marker
Renders a temporary visual point or box marker through walls.
Status Effect
Grants the player a classic Minecraft potion effect (e.g., Speed, Strength, Haste) for a duration.
Play sound
Plays a Minecraft sound effect at the player's position. Ideal for acoustic feedback on triggers.
Spawn Particles
Spawns particle bursts at the target location with custom spread and speed.
Particle Orbit
Creates orbiting particles that rotate continuously around the player.
Reflection (Code)
Allows advanced developers to call direct Java code through the Stones Reflection Engine in game.
Set Field (Reflection)
Directly sets a Java object field value using Reflection.
Instantiate Class
Instantiates a new Java class instance and stores it into a variable.
Execute Command
Executes a silent server command as OP.
Remove Enchantment
Sacrifices a random enchantment from the held weapon and returns its level.
gui.stones.studio.actionselection.condit: Probability
Determines the percentage chance of executing this trigger branch (0.15 = 15%, 1.0 = 100%).
Cooldown ready
Check if the specified cooldown has already expired before the trigger proceeds.
Health Below
Checks if player health is at or below a certain percentage threshold.
Variable Comparison
Compares mathematical context variables (e.g., player HP, RuneLevel, damage) with fixed thresholds.
Compare NBT Data
Compares persistent player NBT storage values against a threshold.
Check Air Supply
Checks if the player still has at least the specified amount of breath underwater.
Check Block
Verifies if the block at the target or crosshair position matches a specific block ID.
Is Raining
Checks if it is currently raining in the world.
Is Thundering
Checks if there is a thunderstorm active in the world.
Is On Fire
Checks if the player is currently burning.
Is Day
Checks if world time is currently daytime.
